rubriker.title: World Championship Game 2: A London in Geneva
rubriker._rss_content: Gukesh Dommaraju and Javokhir Sindarov drew the second game of their World Championship match in Geneva on Wednesday. Playing white for the first time, Gukesh opted for the London System, but found his opponent well-prepared to deal with the relatively cautious opening choice. The defending champion spent considerable time on two key decisions before opting for a threefold repetition. The contenders appear to be testing each other's preparation at this early stage. | Photo: FIDE / Michal Walusza

Gukesh's London System doesn't surprise Sindarov - 2
rubriker._rss_content: Salesforce FIDE World Chess Championship Match Game 2. Gukesh had his first game with the white pieces and chose the London System, because, why not? "It's a cool opening." As it turned out Sindarov came prepared and after just 15 moves he was very comfortably placed. Recognising this Gukesh chose a line that led to a three-fold repetition and a draw on move 20; the position was "super-safe" for both players according to Sindarov.

rubriker.title: I Congreso Educativo en Línea de Ajedrez: Cumbre global de estrategia y pensamiento
rubriker._rss_content: Los días 28 y 29 de noviembre se celebrará el I Congreso Educativo en Línea de Ajedrez 2026, una iniciativa que reunirá a especialistas de distintos ámbitos para explorar las posibilidades formativas del juego ciencia. El encuentro, impulsado desde la Universidad El Bosque de Colombia, tendrá dos grandes ejes temáticos: el desarrollo del pensamiento lógico-matemático y la aplicación del ajedrez como herramienta de gestión, liderazgo y estrategia.
